blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-privacy-1 (E-mail address and display name written to the application log) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-privacy-2 (E-mail address sent to the third-party analytics processor Beacon) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: log.info("new signup email=%s name=%s id=%s", email, display_name, user_id)
findings.recommendation: Log only the opaque `user_id` (e.g. `log.info("new signup id=%s", user_id)`). Every sign-up currently copies the member's e-mail address and display name into the application logs, which have no stated purpose, no retention rule and are not reached by an erasure request (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 5(1)(e) storage limitation, Art. 17 erasure).
findings.title: E-mail address and display name written to the application log

findings.recommendation: Drop `email` from the event: the proposal's purpose is only that "Sign-ups are counted in product analytics", which the event name (and at most the opaque `user_id`) already serves. As written, every sign-up posts the member's e-mail address to `https://beacon.example.com/v1/events` (app/analytics.py:5,9), an external processor the proposal never names — beyond what the purpose needs (Art. 5(1)(c)), out of reach of erasure and access requests (Art. 15, 17), and with no processor agreement or transfer location identified (Art. 28, Chapter V). Also list Beacon as a processor in the proposal's Impact, with its hosting region.
findings.title: E-mail address sent to the third-party analytics processor Beacon

findings.recommendation: Question for the team: the proposal says the change "collects e-mail addresses and display names" but states no purpose per field, no lawful basis, no retention period and no deletion path (backups included) for the stored member record. Only the controller can decide these; record them in the proposal and make sure account deletion removes the record.
findings.title: Purpose, lawful basis and retention of the stored member data not stated
